summary: Fix hyperparameters from pilot CV; preflight fixed spec
reasoning: Replacing the contradicted step-28 plan. Revision is pilot-justified only: batch-5 (10 pilot folds) showed the grid cell the failing inner CV chose (K=50, nn=15; 0.7333) is beaten by (K=40, nn=11; 0.7360, fold-std 0.0192, tightest) and (K=50, nn=7; 0.7452). New analysis: fully pre-specified fixed procedure (PCA-free soft screen K=40, alpha=1, kNN nn=11 manhattan/distance), cv_auc from 3 repeats of 5-fold CV of the fixed procedure, final model refit on all pilot samples, single held-out score. First: pilot-only preflight of the fixed spec across repeat seeds 1-3 to confirm ~0.73+ stability before re-touching heldout.
